verifications.claim: NASA is targeting an April 1, 2026, launch date for the Artemis 2 mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The launch is currently targeting April 1'; R2: 'planned launch on April 1'; R3: 'opportunity for a Wednesday, April 1, launch attempt'; R4: 'working toward an April 1 launch'; R7: 'targeting April 1st as our first opportunity'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state NASA is targeting April 1, 2026, as the launch date.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 mission will send four astronauts on a 10-day trip around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'send four astronauts on a 10-day test flight around the moon'; R2: 'launch four astronauts on a 10-day flight around the moon'; R5: 'orbit the Moon on a 10-day mission'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly confirm four astronauts on a 10-day mission around the Moon.

verifications.claim: The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft were rolled back to launch pad 39B in March 2026 for final preparations following repairs.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'SLS rocket made its long trek from the Vehicle Assembly Building to the launch pad' on March 20 after Feb. 26 return for repairs; R3: 'roll ... from the Vehicle Assembly Building out to Launch Pad 39B' targeting March 20; R4: 'rolling ... back to the launch pad ... March 20'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm second rollout to Pad 39B in March 2026 after repairs in VAB.

verifications.claim: Potential backup launch dates are available in early April.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: available times April 1-6, 30; R2: 'opportunities each day from April 2 to April 6'; R4: 'April 2-6'; R7: 'six launch opportunities ... April 1st to April 6th'
verifications.reasoning: Sources list specific backup dates in early April (e.g., April 2-6).

verifications.claim: The mission goal of Artemis 2 is the first crewed flight of the SLS rocket and Orion capsule around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'first crewed flight of the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft around the Moon'; R4: 'first time that the SLS rocket and the Orion capsule will fly with humans aboard'; R6: 'first time that NASA’s Space Launch System rocket and Orion spacecraft carry people'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly describe Artemis 2 as the first crewed SLS/Orion flight around the Moon.

verifications.claim: The crew of Artemis 2 consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover and Christina Koch and ... Jeremy Hansen'; R5: 'Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Koch, as well as Jeremy Hansen'
verifications.reasoning: All sources list exactly these four astronauts as the Artemis 2 crew.

verifications.claim: The launch site for Artemis 2 is Kennedy Space Center, Florida, Pad 39B.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Kennedy Space Center's Pad 39B'; R5: 'Kennedy Space Center’s LC-39B'; R8: 'Launch Complex-39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center'
verifications.reasoning: Every source confirms Pad 39B at Kennedy Space Center, Florida.

verifications.claim: The SLS rocket has returned to launch pad 39B as of March 20, 2026, for final tests.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'arrived at the launch pad around 9 a.m. Friday morning' (March 20); R6: 'rolls out ... Friday, March 20, 2026'; R7: 'back on the PAD ... final preps ... power up the rocket and ORION CAPSULE to ENSURE ALL THE SYSTEMS ARE WORKING PROPERLY'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm arrival at Pad 39B on March 20, 2026, for final preparations and system checks.

verifications.claim: If the primary April 1, 2026, launch date is missed, subsequent opportunities exist later in the month.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: times through April 6 and '6:06 p.m. April 30'; R2: 'opportunities ... April 2 to April 6, as well as on April 30'; R8: 'opportunities exist through April 6, with another window opening April 30'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly list launch opportunities later in April if April 1 is missed.
